title: Assembling locally constant direct images from disjoint components
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $n\geq0$ be an integer, and let $W_i$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$ be pairwise disjoint open subschemes whose union is $X$. Write $j_i:W_i\to X$ for their inclusions. For an abelian etale sheaf $E$ on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], suppose the underlying set sheaf of $(f\circ j_i)_*(j_i^*E)$ is locally constant for every $i$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then the underlying set sheaf of $f_*E$ is locally constant. No finiteness assumption on $f$, no universal-homeomorphism assumption on the component maps, and no finite-stalk assumption on $E$ is made. The family may be empty.

source.place: ## Proof, finite-algebra calculation and final paragraph

proof.text: For every etale X-scheme V, form its pullbacks along the open inclusions W_i -> X and their projections to V. The ranges are the preimages of W_i, so the cover equation and pairwise disjointness give a disjoint etale cover of V by monomorphisms. Restriction defines a natural map E -> product_i (j_i)_* restriction_i(E). The existing proved theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Etale.isIso_piLift_of_disjoint makes its section maps isomorphisms, after the standard evaluation/product comparison. Sheaves are a full subcategory of presheaves, so the map is an isomorphism. This includes the empty family.

Apply f_* to the source product isomorphism. The direct-image functor is right adjoint and preserves products. Use Etale.lowerStarComp and Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction to identify its factors with (j_i followed by f)_*(j_i^*E). Postcomposition with the forgetful functor from abelian groups preserves products: this follows on presheaves from preservation by forget, and descends to sheaves because sheafToPresheaf reflects limits. Thus the underlying set sheaf of f_*E is isomorphic to the product of the underlying component images.

Finite products of constant set sheaves are constant. Choose the values and constant-sheaf isomorphisms witnessing constancy; Pi.mapIso and PreservesProduct.iso identify the product with the constant sheaf of the product of the values. The instance preservesFiniteLimits_constantSheaf follows from the finite-limit preservation of the constant-presheaf functor and left exact sheafification. Constancy of F.over V persists on F.over U for a map U -> V in the small etale site: Over.map is continuous and cocontinuous, so pushforwardContinuousSheafificationCompatibility identifies restriction of a constant sheaf with the constant sheaf of the same value; Sheaf.pushforwardOverMapIso supplies the restriction comparison.

Induct on the length of a finite family of locally constant sheaves. For the empty family use the identity etale cover. For a successor, take a trivializing cover for the first factor and a simultaneous cover for the remaining factors given by induction, then bind the first cover with the pullback of the second. Both projections give morphisms of the small etale site to the original cover members; the previous localization argument shows all factors are constant there. Restriction over a site object preserves products, so the finite product is constant on this common cover. Apply this construction to the component images and transport each constant restriction along the product isomorphism from step 2, using Sheaf.isConstant_congr. No new hypothesis is needed when n = 0.

theorem isLocallyConstant_disjoint_components_directImage
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → X.Opens)
    (hcover : (⨆ i, W i) = ⊤)
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (W i) (W j)))
    (E : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hcomponents : ∀ i, IsLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology
        (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((W i).ι ≫ f)).obj
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (W i).ι).obj E)))) :
    IsLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology
        (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj E))
